propose.plain_language_voice: The request has all trustworthy, current, and complete context needed before checking whether a role grants the permission.

propose.normative_voice: The AuthorizationDecision value produced for every in-scope AuthorizationRequest that does not have both AuthorizationAdmissible context and an ExactActiveRoleGrant.
propose.formal_voice: Decision(q) = DENY <-> not exists s,t,v. AuthorizationAdmissible(q,s,t,v) and ExactActiveRoleGrant(q,s). The AuthorizationDecision value produced for every in-scope AuthorizationRequest that does not have both AuthorizationAdmissible context and an ExactActiveRoleGrant.
propose.plain_language_voice: Deny is the default answer whenever the request is not both admissible and exactly granted.
propose.domain_context_voice: This DENY is the absence of a valid positive authorization result. It is not an explicit DENY grant or deny-precedence rule.
propose.boundary: Do not collapse DENY into an explicit negative grant, deny precedence, authentication failure, or proof of malicious intent.
